method: Batch 36. Same double, row layout, script ops and record fields as village-fight-b35-reference.json, plus: the mob type `C` (EntityChicken, laying on the timer `egg` = timeUntilNextEgg set on each chicken); the script op `t spawn x z y yaw` (SpawnerAnimals order: a zombie is placed with its yaw, World.spawnEntityInWorld (refused in an unloaded chunk) and EntityZombie.onSpawnWithEgg(null) run, whose child roll and chicken-jockey rolls draw on World.rand, seeded with the record seed); `spawns` lists [tick, spawned, child, 0 none / 1 nearby chicken mounted / 2 new chicken, index of the nearby chicken, a new chicken was spawned, the zombie Entity.rand seed]; `chickens` lists each chicken a baby zombie spawned [tick, x, y, z, Entity.rand seed, yaw, head yaw, jockey flag, egg timer]; rows carry a 6th element (the spawned chickens: x, y, z, health, jockey flag, draws) and a 7th (the jockey flags of the starting chickens). A rider is updated right after its mount (World.updateEntityWithOptionalForce) except one the world refused, which is never ticked. Held items: the probe runs the equipment sync of EntityLivingBase.onUpdate (previousEquipment against the held stack, attribute modifiers moved) at the start of each update, so `equip` (before the tick) takes effect in that update and `equipmid` (after the mob own update) in its next one. Gates and doors on a one-block plateau, a house on a raised base, and villagers fleeing across the stacked storeys of batch 35.
